body:
# Place on Path (PoP)

Tired of your dirt/grass paths turning back into plain dirt the moment you place a fence, lantern or flower on them? Place on Path fixes exactly that.

Place **any block** on a path and the path stays - it's swapped for a seamless full‑height version, so there's no ugly gap to the block on top. Remove the block and it turns back into a normal path.

## Features
- Place any block on dirt/grass paths without them turning to dirt
- No gap - the path becomes full‑height under the block and reverts when the block is removed
- Place plants, flowers, saplings and doors on paths too
- In‑game config screen (Mods menu): every block is green (keeps the path) by default - click a block to turn it red, and that block will turn the path to dirt instead. Toggle whole categories or single blocks, with a search bar.
- Lightweight and server‑friendly

## Available for
- **Fabric**: 1.16.5 · 1.18.2 · 1.19.2 · 1.19.4 · 1.20.1 · 1.20.4 · 1.21.1 · 1.21.4
- **Forge**: 1.18.2 · 1.19.2 · 1.19.4 · 1.20.1 · 1.20.4
- **NeoForge**: 1.20.4 · 1.21.1 · 1.21.4
  
## Dependencies
- **Architectury API** - required (all versions)
- **Fabric API** - required (Fabric only)
- **Mod Menu** - optional (Fabric, for the config button)
